items.title: Roy McCurdy interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, November 16, 1995
items.q: We did an album with Cannon and Joe, a live record for Fantasy Records I believe it was.

ctx.x: With a big band, you know there was just a few of us. And we only did the cars for a while, and then we started flying everyplace, so it was good. It wasn’t bad.
Did you ever have an opportunity to play behind Joe Williams?
Sure. I love Joe. We did an album with Cannon and Joe, a live record for Fantasy Records I believe it was.
